title: Fullerton California Toddler, Wicker Basket - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: FADE PROOF APR 2 1 1939 Finished by B. D. WOOD Fullerton, California 70 A
description: A charming candid snapshot capturing an inquisitive toddler standing on an open lawn beside a stout tree trunk and a dense garden hedge. The young child wears a dark button-up cardigan with decorative white edging at the collar and cuffs, paired with floral-patterned trousers and soft baby shoes, while carefully gripping the handle of a small woven wicker basket, likely during an outdoor spring or Easter celebration. The photo bears a studio or photo-finisher stamp from B. D. Wood in Fullerton, California, dated April 21, 1939, capturing everyday American family life on the eve of World War II.
